shasta.definition:
n. a member of the Indian people of northern California and southern Oregon
n. a volcanic mountain peak in the Cascade Range in northern California (14,162 feet high)
n. the Shastan language spoken by the Shasta

shastra.definition:
n. A treatise for authoritative instruction among the
   Hindoos; a book of institutes; especially, a treatise explaining the
   Vedas.

shastracara.translation: n. 符合印度教圣典原则的行为
